_comment: Which schema versions each release can run against, as inclusive ranges of migration timestamps. Updated in the same pull request as every migration. Used by scripts/rollback_check.py before any rollback.

school-app/v1.note: reads and writes full_name, which the contract migration drops

school-app/v2.note: needs display_name (expand) and still writes full_name (dual write)

school-app/v3.note: reads and writes display_name only; needs the contract migration
